mapper.update: UPDATE resource_dispatch SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, response_id, resource_id, status, dispatch_time, eta_minutes, comment, location, recovered_time, create_time, update_time, creator, updater, deleted FROM resource_dispatch WHERE response_id = #{responseId} AND deleted = false ORDER BY create_time DESC
